audience: shops and businesses that send same-day courier deliveries to customers through LastFolk

useCases.title: Price a delivery before you dispatch it
useCases.text: Get a quote for a pickup and a drop-off address. The quote reserves nothing and charges nothing. It is single-use and expires at a set time.

useCases.title: Confirm the key works before you dispatch
useCases.text: Check the identity of the key, then check that its environment matches the courier account. A mismatch is an error.

useCases.title: Dispatch a delivery for an order
useCases.text: Dispatch a courier job against an unused quote. Use the order id as the idempotency key, so a retry never sends a second courier. Dispatching starts billing.

useCases.title: Track today's deliveries
useCases.text: List your deliveries, filtered by status, order id or created date. Open one delivery to read its status, tracking link and ETAs.

useCases.title: Cancel a delivery before pickup
useCases.text: Cancel a delivery that the courier has not collected yet. After pickup, the API refuses the cancel.
